description: Random voltage generator: a new value on each trigger or at a rate of its own, drawn from a flat or a bell-shaped spread, with a gate output that fires on the higher draws

params.text: Switches between drawing a new value at the module's own rate and drawing one on each incoming trigger; the lamp in the Trig group lights while triggers are used
Sets how long each drawn value is held, from a new value on every sample at the counter-clockwise end to one every 2ms at the clockwise end
Switches the draw between a flat spread from zero upwards and a bell curve centred on zero, which is what puts negative voltages on the outputs
Scales the drawn voltage: on the flat setting the value reaches five volts times this, and on the bell setting it sets the width of the curve

inputs.text: A rising edge above 1V draws a new value; this jack is read only while the Trig switch is set to use triggers
Added to the hold time in whole samples, one volt lengthening it by one sample
Added to the range knob, one volt raising it by a twentieth of that knob's whole travel

outputs.text: A gate whose high level is five volts times the range setting, fired when the drawn value passes a threshold: zero on the bell setting and 2.5V on the flat one
The drawn voltage itself, held until the next value is drawn

notes: on the flat setting the gate output tests against a fixed 2.5V while the value drawn only reaches five volts times the range knob, so at or below that knob's middle it never leaves 0V
the module comes up free-running with the hold time at nothing, so it draws a fresh value every sample and its output is white noise until the hold knob is turned up
the maker gave no name to any knob or jack here, so hovering one of them shows nothing

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
